#*Experience Boston Harbor like never before!*
___________________________________


## Rates
**Private Sailing Charter:** From $565.00
*All Ages welcome | Price includes up to 6 people*
___________________________________
## Duration
2 hours 
___________________________________
## About
Come enjoy a 2-hour sail around the Boston Harbor! Sail with us around the inner harbor to see the BEST of Boston including Seaport, Southie, Castle Island, Spectacle Island, Eastie, Charlestown, and The North End. Let us regale you with the history of these places, or just listen to some music and enjoy a leisurely sail around the harbor. We specialize in hosting private events; birthdays, anniversaries, proposals… we do it all. Complimentary soda, water, ice are always on board and you’re welcome to BYOB anything else you wish!
data.cancellation_notes: Payment is due at time of booking and sales are final. Customers will receive full credit in case of operator cancellation due to hazardous weather or other unforeseen circumstances. Contact us by phone if your circumstances require re-scheduling charter. Note: Any requests for rescheduling must be done at least 24 hours before your scheduled charter.
